name: Care@Home
tagline: AI that Cares for Aging at Home
description: Developing a cutting-edge AI-based contactless monitoring ecosystem that supports independent living, reduces healthcare workload, and improves quality of life for older adults.

funding.statement: This project received funding from Research Council of Lithuania (LMTLT), agreement No S-THCS-26-2 under the frame of Transforming Health and Care Systems, THCS, (GA N° 101095654 of the EU Horizon Europe Research and Innovation Programme)
